scope: Homepage visual and typography reference research for an India travel agency concept

method.visualEvidence: Screenshots opened with view_image; desktop 1440x1000, selected mobile 390x844
method.fontEvidence: getComputedStyle(element).fontFamily and loaded document.fonts entries on live rendered pages
method.note: Computed site font-family names are observed implementation identifiers; no reference font binaries were copied.

references.name: Pelorus

fonts.use: Serif supporting line and editorial paragraphs

observations: Two-level ivory header: centered wordmark with utilities, then spaced uppercase category navigation.
Large genuine moving landscape hero, left-aligned condensed statement and restrained ochre enquiry action.
Typographic contrast comes from three clear jobs: condensed display, literary serif prose, practical sans navigation.
Editorial whitespace and a few large images establish luxury before exhaustive product browsing.
adapt: Give genuine Varanasi photography the largest visual area.
Distinguish evocative headline typography from practical itinerary and planning UI.
Use a single visible planning action with generous breathing room.
avoid: Do not duplicate its condensed all-caps hero, dual-row masthead, ochre button composition or reference prose.
Cookie overlay remained in early captures; the final desktop capture is unobstructed. The overlay is an inspection artifact, not a proposed UX pattern.

references.name: Wander

fonts.use: Body and headings; hero observed 52px weight 550

observations: Small persistent Where / When / Who search capsule dominates navigation, while the introductory hero is compact.
Browse rows prioritize large almost-square photographs, then concise name, rating and price metadata.
On mobile the segmented search becomes one 'Start your search' control and horizontal cards reveal the next item.
Photography and a restrained type system carry the quality without ornamental UI.
adapt: Use Instrument Sans for legible navigation, filters and journey metadata.
Preserve obvious planning entry points and consistent image/caption rhythm.
Mobile cards should show a portion of the next item; provide actual touch and keyboard scroll support.
avoid: Initial desktop media appeared black while loading; the final desktop capture confirmed the fully loaded photographic hero. Do not use the transient black state as inspiration.
Do not reproduce its five-column property catalog for a small specialist travel brand.

references.name: Airbnb

fonts.use: Live body and headings; custom variable sans

observations: Search is structured around Where, When, Who with generous individual hit areas.
Browse is organized into clearly named, locally meaningful rows with compact consistent metadata.
Photography, white space, small ratings and a single pink primary search action make a dense page scannable.
Desktop screenshot rendered regional Varanasi listings; mobile inspection remained in a loading state.
adapt: Make the planner's field hierarchy and selected state immediately understandable.
Keep card facts predictable and remove labels that do not help a traveler choose.
avoid: Do not copy the pink search capsule, brand font or property-catalog styling.
Mobile screenshot was a transient loading state with overflow; it is insufficient evidence of completed mobile UX.

references.name: Polarsteps
observations: A full-bleed vivid landscape leads into a warm cream canvas.
The actual trip map/route appears in a large phone prototype and explains the product before paragraphs do.
Scroll progression separates planning, tracking and reliving into discrete visual chapters.
Only a few large narrative elements compete for attention at each point.
adapt: Explain connected North India circuits with a simple route sequence rather than a pile of destination adjectives.
Let each homepage section answer one traveler question.
Use warmth in the paper color and genuine imagery, with disciplined spacing.
avoid: Do not copy the tilted phone, branded handwritten labels, tropical scene or centered app-marketing hero.

references.name: Armenia Travel
observations: Cinematic destination video has strongly rounded lower corners, followed by a separate title/caption band.
Navigation distinguishes learning about the place, finding places, things to do, and planning logistics.
Strong contrast between navy chapters and light sections, with a single yellow accent and distinctive locally expressive typography.
Mobile reorders into a compact logo/menu, short cropped image, large wrapped title, then explanatory paragraph; it is visibly recomposed.
adapt: Build cultural specificity into content hierarchy, imagery, captions and editorial typography.
Give Varanasi its own substantial story section and use the other cities as linked ways to extend the journey.
Recompose the hero and planner for mobile instead of scaling the desktop overlap.
avoid: Do not reuse its proprietary geometric letterforms, rounded video frame or dark collage section.

references.name: Exoticca

fonts.use: Body and display; headings observed 48px weight 500

observations: The live captured homepage is a promotion campaign with prominent sale banner, photographic carousel and a segmented trip finder.
Tall tour cards clearly show destination route, number of days and commercial terms.
Fixed top navigation keeps destinations, trip style and help reachable while browsing.
Large simple typography keeps a dense commercial offer understandable.
adapt: Always place route and duration visibly on itinerary previews.
Keep the journey-planning action accessible after long editorial sections.
Use transparent proposed itineraries and request-a-quote language until client prices are confirmed.
avoid: Discount tags, urgency, countdowns and savings claims do not belong in this concept without client evidence.
Do not copy the campaign art direction, pricing or tour descriptions.

proposedDirection.name: The river and the road
proposedDirection.positioning: A personal, well-informed journey through North India, beginning with Varanasi and extending to the user's eight focus cities.
proposedDirection.palette: Warm limestone/paper, deep umber text, one restrained clay or vermilion action color; implement in OKLCH.

typography.display: Newsreader roman and selectively italic; large but readable, editorial rather than ornate
typography.body: Instrument Sans for navigation, metadata and forms
typography.rationale: Newsreader introduces a distinctive literary voice while Instrument Sans directly follows the usability quality verified on Wander. DM Sans is acceptable if already implemented, but Instrument Sans makes the researched reference relationship concrete.

proposedDirection.hero: Genuine recognizable riverfront photography, restrained left headline, location caption and one planning action. Preserve image detail rather than relying on an opaque dark wash.
structure: A few clearly labeled proposed itinerary previews with route and duration
Useful travel-planning details and browser-local brief
proposedDirection.planner: Destination + journey interest + party type, with a clear 'Shape my journey' action. Dates can be optional; no simulated live inventory.
proposedDirection.mobile: Planner in normal flow, simplified header, independently composed image crop and typography, visible next-card edge on destination rail, touch/keyboard controls and no body overflow.
guardrails: No invented business brand, years of experience, testimonials, ratings, prices, availability, client counts or guarantees.
Do not use reference image assets or proprietary font binaries.
No decorative spiritual symbols or generic palace/temple mashups.
Keep ordinary visitors focused on travel; communicate concept status unobtrusively, not in a developer-oriented flow.
